missions.name: Mission 1
missions.description: Survive for 30 seconds as deadly comets rain down. Destroy them or dodge — do whatever it takes to reach the next level.

missions.name: Mission 2
missions.description: Defeat all asteroids and avoid getting hit. Only the strongest will survive.

missions.name: Mission 3
missions.description: Face the final boss and prove your skill in battle. Only one will emerge victorious.
